definitions.explanation: Describes a standard, judgment, or process that treats all parties equally without bias or favoritism.

examples.japanese: {公正|こうせい}な⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|くだ}す→下す：12329_kudasu⟧。
⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{公正|こうせい}に⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧べきだ。

{公正|こうせい}な⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}→導入：10127_dounyuu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: New rules were introduced to ensure fair trading.

notes:
Describes fairness and impartiality in judgments, processes, and systems. Frequently used in legal, political, and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公正|こうせい}な⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧: fair judgment
- {公正|こうせい}な⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧: fair trade/dealing
- {公正|こうせい}な⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧: fair election
- {公正|こうせい}な⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧: fair competition
- ⟦{公正|こうせい}→公正：01751_kousei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{期|き}す: to ensure fairness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{公平|こうへい}→公平：01648_kouhei⟧な: fair, equal — focuses on equal treatment of all parties; often interchangeable but ⟦{公平|こうへい}→公平：01648_kouhei⟧ emphasizes equal distribution while ⟦{公正|こうせい}→公正：01751_kousei⟧ emphasizes rightness of process
- ⟦{適正|てきせい}→適正：09686_tekisei⟧な: proper, appropriate — focuses on being correct and suitable rather than unbiased
- ⟦{中立|ちゅうりつ}→中立：11324_chuuritsu⟧な: neutral — emphasizes not taking sides rather than active fairness

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{公正|こうせい}→公正：01751_kousei⟧⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧ (Fair Trade Commission) — a major government body in Japan that enforces antitrust law.
